purpose: Converts map_blueprint + map_structure + style_profile into concrete render directives and asset generation targets. Bridge between planning (Strategy/Structure/Style) and execution (A9 Asset Generation Agent).

style_profile.description: Visual family, palette, line treatment, icons, background

render_prompt.description: Concrete prompt for Midjourney/DALL-E/Recraft: directives for map composition, POI placement, route visualization, label strategy. Format: subject + style + composition + technical specs.
render_prompt.example: Editorial map of Kyoto neighborhoods. Primary focus: Gion, Arashiyama, Higashiyama districts with tea houses, temples, craft shops as primary POI. Routes: walking paths between districts (dashed lines). Style: black line art, editorial serif labels, 2-color palette (charcoal + cream), Snazzy Maps-inspired minimalism. Label density: medium (readable but not cluttered). Aspect ratio: 16:10 landscape. No photographs. No watercolor. No 3D.

fields.color_mode: string (e.g., 'RGB for screen + CMYK for print')

render_mode.description: How to generate: single continuous render vs. layer-by-layer vs. geographic zones vs. route-focused

asset_generation_targets.description: Specific assets to generate (not just one map, but component breakdown)

items.subject: string
items.post_render_treatment: string (e.g., 'isolate on transparent', 'colorize legend', 'add drop shadow')

fields.safe_zone_margins: string (e.g., '0.5 inch top/bottom for title; 0.25 inch left/right')
fields.route_line_weight: string (e.g., '1.5 pt for primary, 0.75 pt for secondary')

post_render_checks.description: Validation checklist for A10 (QA Agent) after generation

composition_logic.description: Step-by-step composition instructions for asset gen pipeline

fields.layering_order: array of strings (layer sequence: base → primary_areas → secondary → poi_groups → routes → legend)
fields.poi_grouping_visual_strategy: string (how to distinguish groups: color, icon style, size, clustering)
fields.label_strategy: string (placement, font sizing, hierarchy, serif vs sans)

rehoming_candidates.description: POI/route/area that fit style but aren't in final render (for rehoming_log.json)

confidence.description: Confidence that this render will pass QA on first attempt

needs_human_review.description: Flag if composition logic is complex or untested and needs human cartographer sign-off before render

map_blueprint.product_goal: Educational coloring + reference guide for Kyoto neighborhoods
map_blueprint.narrative_goal: Show how Kyoto's geisha and craft districts are organized and connected

route_layers: Walking path: Higashiyama ↔ Arashiyama (45 min, via temple circuit)

output.render_prompt: Editorial map of Kyoto neighborhoods showing geisha and craft districts. Primary focus: Gion (south), Arashiyama (west), Higashiyama (east). Include: tea houses (teacup icon), temples/shrines (torii icon), craft shops (hammer icon). Routes: walking paths between districts (dashed lines, labeled with time estimates). Style: black line art on warm cream background, editorial minimalist, Snazzy Maps-inspired, 2-color palette (charcoal + accent), serif labels. Label density: medium (readable without clutter). Avoid: modern commercial, parking lots, tourist infrastructure. Medium detail level. Aspect ratio: 16:10 landscape. No photographs, no watercolor, no 3D, no fills.

render_spec.color_mode: RGB for screen, CMYK export for print

asset_generation_targets.subject: Kyoto neighborhood boundaries, water, primary streets
Tea houses, tea-related locations with teacup icons
asset_generation_targets.post_render_treatment: Overlay on transparent, color accent = warm brown

asset_generation_targets.subject: Temples and shrines with torii gate icons
Walking paths between districts, dashed lines with time labels

layout_constraints.safe_zone_margins: 0.5 in top (title), 0.25 in left/right, 0.5 in bottom (legend)
layout_constraints.route_line_weight: 1.5 pt primary streets, 0.75 pt secondary, 0.5 pt walking routes

post_render_checks: All POI icons visible and correctly placed
Route labels legible and properly positioned
Color palette matches style_profile (charcoal + cream + 2 accents)
Background treatment matches specification (warm cream, no texture)

composition_logic.base_map_foundation: Neighborhood boundaries (black 1.5pt lines) + water areas (white) on cream background
layering_order: Primary areas (subtle shading or boundary highlight)
Labels (hierarchy: district names largest, POI names medium, route times small)
composition_logic.poi_grouping_visual_strategy: Each group has distinct icon style. Tea = teacup (warm brown accent). Sacred = torii (black). Craft = hammer (secondary accent). All icons 20–30 px, line art, no fills.
composition_logic.route_visualization: Walking routes = 0.5pt dashed black lines. Time labels inline or nearby: '20 min walk'. No arrows, just dashed pattern to show pedestrian movement.
composition_logic.label_strategy: Serif font (editorial). District names: 18pt bold, charcoal. POI names: 11pt regular, charcoal. Route times: 9pt italic, charcoal. All labels have subtle background clearance (no text over icons).
composition_logic.background_treatment: Warm cream (#F5F3EE), solid, no texture or pattern

rehoming_candidates.suggested_future_home: Expanded map: Kyoto Walking Circuits (multi-day edition)
rehoming_candidates.why: Fits product goal but too long for neighborhood focus. Strong for future route-focused map.
Important but not central to geisha/craft narrative. Better as centerpiece of different map.

governance_notes.ownership_clarity: This agent is a translator, not a creator. It consumes planning outputs and converts them to execution directives.
governance_notes.no_strategic_revision: If Map Strategy/Structure/Style need changes, those go back to their agents, not here.
governance_notes.revision_protocol: Map Generation Agent does not have revision loop. It produces render_prompt once. If rejected by QA, failure escalates to appropriate upstream agent (Strategy/Structure/Style).
governance_notes.quality_gate_handoff: Output must include post_render_checks that QA Agent will validate. Generation Agent is responsible for feasibility assessment, not final QA.
governance_notes.rehoming_integration: Map Generation Agent identifies POI/routes/areas that are brand-fit but not in this render. These go to rehoming_log.json for future homes (G7 governance rule).
